about.heading: Über mich
paragraphs: Ich bin Softwareentwickler mit beruflicher Erfahrung im Aufbau und der Wartung von Backend-Systemen, APIs, Datenbanken und Geschäftsanwendungen. Meine stärkste Erfahrung liegt in PHP und Laravel - Backend-Logik, APIs, Datenbanken, Debugging und die Umsetzung fachlicher Anforderungen.
Außerdem habe ich Erfahrung mit Python und Interesse an datenbezogenen und KI/ML-Anwendungen. Mir geht es darum, mit Software echte geschäftliche Probleme zu lösen.

Derzeit studiere ich einen MSc in Software Engineering im Vereinigten Königreich, um mein Wissen im Systemdesign und im Aufbau größerer, zuverlässiger Software-Systeme zu vertiefen. Mein langfristiges Ziel ist es, reale Softwareprodukte zu entwickeln und eigene Produkte aufzubauen.

about.heading: About Me
paragraphs: I'm a Software Engineer with 5+ years of hands-on experience developing web applications, backend systems, REST APIs, databases and business management platforms.

My strongest professional experience is in PHP, Laravel, MySQL and backend development. I've worked on real-world systems including logistics and vehicle management, e-commerce, CRM and HRM, inventory and distribution, online examination and learning platforms, sales reporting, API integrations and custom business applications.

I also have professional experience with Python, JavaScript, React.js, WordPress and Frappe CRM/ERP. I enjoy understanding real business problems, working with existing systems, debugging complex issues and turning requirements into practical software.

I'm currently pursuing an MSc in Software Engineering in the UK, where I'm strengthening my knowledge of software architecture, system design, engineering practices and modern software development. I'm particularly interested in scalable systems, automation, AI/data-driven applications and building products that solve real problems.

items.name: E-commerce Website
items.description: Designed and developed a production e-commerce platform for a Nepal-based supplier of printers, toner and ink cartridges, photocopy parts, heat-transfer and sublimation machines, stationery and related equipment. Built the customer storefront and admin panel for product catalogue management, shopping cart, wishlist, ordering, promotions, stock visibility and order/payment workflows. This was my first end-to-end e-commerce project and remains in use by the client.

items.name: TOPIK / EPS-TOPIK Exam Preparation Platform
items.description: Developed an online learning and mock-examination platform for TOPIK and EPS-TOPIK preparation. The system combines an administrative CMS with a student dashboard for managing exam sets, question banks, e-books, test packages, purchases, computer-based practice tests, test history and detailed results across reading, listening and other exam sections.

items.name: Logistics & Vehicle Management System
items.description: Designed the overall software architecture, database structure, backend workflows and REST API architecture for a logistics and vehicle management system. The platform manages vehicles, drivers, trips, goods, locations, expenses and operational data, with reporting designed to turn large amounts of transport data into useful business information. Frontend structure and user flows were designed in collaboration with another developer who implemented the frontend.

items.name: Ice-Cream Distribution & Asset Management System
items.description: Designed and developed a specialised management system for an ice-cream distribution business covering factory-to-service-centre inventory flow, retailer operations, freezer asset tracking and security deposits. Implemented multi-level distribution workflows, role-based access, asset tracking, financial ledger functionality, inventory transfers, invoicing, PDF generation and retailer geolocation.

items.name: NGO CRM & HRM System
items.description: Worked on a large-scale NGO management system built on Frappe CRM/ERP, customising CRM and HRM modules to support organisation-specific workflows and business processes. Worked with custom forms, fields, workflows, business logic, configuration, debugging, testing and feature enhancements beyond standard platform functionality.

items.name: Business Management & CRM Systems
